eps.o: It's the summer of 1981 in Los Angeles; a series of disturbing crimes coincides with the arrival of a strange new student in Bret's orbit.
Bret digs deeper into Robert's murky past and uncovers shocking evidence.
A beloved student's sudden disappearance causes chaos for the senior class.
Susan's welcome party for Robert is overshadowed by a terrifying and violent incident.
A televised dance competition culminates with a horrifying showstopper.
Troubled Debbie is galvanized by a new extracurricular.
A surprising Homecoming King and Queen are crowned as the Trawler's killing spree continues.
Something turns rotten in the state of California, as two blackmail plots reveal two devastating secrets.
With the city on lockdown, Debbie hosts a Halloween party that will change everything.
